zh-Hans: 就这么输了，我非被全队笑死不可！哪怕拼个平手，也得保住面子！
en: If I lose like this, the whole team will laugh at me! Even a draw will save my pride!
I won't go easy on you!

zh-Hans: 让我看看你能撑过几个弯！
en: Let's see how many corners you can survive!

zh-Hans: 算了，反正赢的肯定是我。

en: Oh, you've got some fight in you!

zh-Hans: 再着急点才对啊！来啊，给我使劲攻！
en: You should be getting desperate! Come on, push harder!

zh-Hans: 我就在后面狠狠逼你，直到你撞车！
en: I'll keep piling on the pressure until you crash!
This is no fun. You're pissing me off.

zh-Hans: 为什么？这么逼他都没乱！
en: Why? All this pressure, and he still won't crack!
His corner entry's too fast! I can't follow!

zh-Hans: 怎么可能！我的 CIVIC 可是 NIGHT KIDS 下坡最快的！
en: Impossible! My CIVIC is the fastest downhill car in the Night Kids!

zh-Hans: 已经压到极限了，还是没法再逼近！
en: I'm right on the limit! I can't push any harder!

zh-Hans: 一口气冲进红区的声音……这感觉，简直爽死了！
en: Straight into the redline! That sound, that rush... I can't get enough!

zh-Hans: 能赢就行，管他用什么手段！
en: A win's a win, no matter what it takes!

zh-Hans: 我故意收油跟到后面，就是想好好看场戏。
en: I backed off on purpose. I wanted a front-row seat.

zh-Hans: 竟然在这种地方被超了！
怎么可能……这根本不是平常说的快慢，完全是另一个层次！
en: Impossible... This isn't about being fast or slow. He's on a completely different level!

zh-Hans: 那种家伙，怎么会有这么厉害的技术？！
en: How does a guy like him have that kind of skill?!
You're all over the place. Pathetic.
No one's beating me for speed!

zh-Hans: 追上又怎样，不让他超就行！
en: Let him catch up. All I have to do is keep him behind me!

zh-Hans: 光赢还不够，我可不会满足！
靠过来了，差距一下就缩短了！
en: He's coming! He's closing the gap fast!
I'll leave you in the dust!

zh-Hans: 来啊来啊，刚才的气势哪去了？
en: Come on! Where'd all that confidence go?
Now I'll show you what I can really do!

zh-Hans: 群马下坡最快的，就是 NIGHT KIDS 的庄司慎吾！
en: The fastest downhill racer in Gunma is Shingo Shoji of the Night Kids!

zh-Hans: 让你见识见识下坡赛有多残酷！
en: I'll show you just how brutal downhill racing can be!

zh-Hans: 我可没阿毅那么好说话！
en: I'm not as soft as Takeshi!
